dropdown-height:
Dropdown Height

DropdownMinHeightClass and DropdownMaxHeightClass cap the option list. MaxVisibleOptions caps it to a row count and wins over both. Type one letter to load enough options to see the cap.

Usage 

@uiForm.RemoteSearchableSelectInput(uiForm.RemoteSearchableSelectInputSettings{
	InputName:       "country",
	Label:           "Country",
	OptionsUrl:      "/api/countries/search",
	TwoWayStatePath: "country",

	// OptionalFields
	MinQueryLength:        1,
	DropdownMinHeightClass: "min-h-24",
	DropdownMaxHeightClass: "max-h-40",
	MaxVisibleOptions:      3,
})

multi-select:
Multi-Select

IsMultiSelect binds an array. The trigger keeps the selected labels while the query and the options change.

Usage 

@uiForm.RemoteSearchableSelectInput(uiForm.RemoteSearchableSelectInputSettings{
	InputName:  "countries",
	Label:      "Countries",
	OptionsUrl: "/api/countries/search",

	// OptionalFields
	TwoWayStatePath: "countries",
	IsMultiSelect:   true,
})

preset-value:
Preset Value

InitialOptions labels a value that is already bound, so the trigger shows the label and the dropdown lists it before any request. A fetched option wins for the same value.

Usage 

@uiForm.RemoteSearchableSelectInput(uiForm.RemoteSearchableSelectInputSettings{
	InputName:       "country",
	Label:           "Country",
	OptionsUrl:      "/api/countries/search",
	TwoWayStatePath: "country",

	// OptionalFields
	InitialOptions: []uiForm.SelectLabelValueOption{
		{Label: "Brazil", Value: "Brazil"},
	},
})

query-settings:
Query Settings

OptionsQueryParam names the query parameter, MinQueryLength gates the first request, and DebounceMs waits before each request.

Usage 

@uiForm.RemoteSearchableSelectInput(uiForm.RemoteSearchableSelectInputSettings{
	InputName:  "country",
	Label:      "Country",
	OptionsUrl: "/api/countries/search",

	// OptionalFields
	OptionsQueryParam: "countryName",
	MinQueryLength:    1,
	DebounceMs:        800,
	TwoWayStatePath:   "country",
})
